title: Field Adoption Sprint: Enablement Kits & Hands-on Demo Flows
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: deliver a compact, field-ready enablement kit for Sales and Customer Success that enables rapid demos, consistent messaging, and fast follow-through on Intelliroute capabilities. Kit must include a battlecard (value props, competitive matrix, pricing sensitivity cues, objection handlers), a one-page quick reference, a 10-minute live demo script (curl + SDK snippets), three FAQ scenarios (pricing/SLAs/data privacy), two short walkthrough videos (screen + voiceover), and release-note alignment (what to publish, known issues, rollback guidance). Coordination required with Engineering for the demo environment, Design for visual assets, Docs for release notes and API snippets, and Growth for launch comms. The assets should be usable by a field rep with <30 minutes prep time.

Release notes entry finalized and cross-referenced in all enablement materials

demo_script_outline: Intro (30s): 30s elevator pitch + product positioning vs self-hosted inferencing
Setup (1m): show staging dashboard, verify model version, highlight routing/pinning options
Live walkthrough (5m): run 3 short prompts showing latency, batch efficiency, and fallback to quantized variant
